nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Tight 'n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner

avis.texte: I'm not sure if I got a bad can but this is extremely watery. It's not foam or mouse like. it's the same consistency as shaking up a bottle of soapy water. it does stink and it is sticky. if you put it on after your moisturizer which is opposite of what you do with a toner and tightener it doesn't feel a sticky.
Sticky and stinky product. I would not reccomend this. It pills underneath my makeup and the rest of my skincare.

avis.titre: Easy, effortless step in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I love this product. I use it on my face in the morning after cleansing and it really feels like it tightens my mature skin. I love that I can apply it with my fingers and it absorbs into the skin without feeling sticky. 1-2 pumps is all you need and it layers beautifully under serum and moisturizer.

I have no idea what some of these people have against this product cause nothing the negative reviews say is true. Its not sticky especially since its not the last product in your routine. It doesn't smell bad, if anything it just smells like a more medical grade product. It freaking works! Its also super easy to apply and I love the application method. I don't like waste like cotton rounds. This u can just apply with your fingers.
used it once after my regular facial cleansing, applied all over my face as you would a normal toner and it burned so bad. had to rinse it off immediately and just wait for my skin to stop burning :/

I was SUPER excited to try this cause I heard some good reviews ... BUT it's crap! Like what a waste of money ! First off it smells terrible then after using just a small amount it left my whole face super sticky afterwards. I would give it zero stars if I could! Super disappointed

What is the purpose of the foaming? Is it meant to be easier, fun maybe? It's honestly more of a hassle because I have to change my routine to accommodate this product. Also the stinging. I'm not new to acids, nor do I have sensitive skin but this toner makes my face sting. Why? Nobody needs this. I love Benefit but they dropped the ball on this one
Has a pump top and is dispensed in a foam. Works really well, has really shrunk my pores to microscopic. My only complaint would be that it can sting a bit when applied.
one of the worst products I've ever bought. did nothing but make my skin sticky and very shiny 😔

I seriously LOVE ANYTHING by "POREfessional." This brand literally hasn't let me down, NOT ONCE w/ any product I've gotten by them. The name says it all! I ❤️ my "Tight 'N Toned" toning foam. The moment it hits my skin, I feel the product working its magic. My pores look much smaller, not visible, & it leaves my skin feeling/looking baby bum soft/porcelain.. ⭐️💫🌟✨💫 ALL DAY, HANDS DOWN!

I love this product because it's clean, light weight, no residue, easy to apply, and it goes a long way. A little dab on the tip of your finger. After cleaning my face I apply my moisturizer and the product because my skin is super sensitive. This might not be the right order for those professionals but it works for me. My skin is flawless and the pores are invisible. Try it you might like it :) Also, its inexpensive.

WHY is no one saying it burns?! I used this after the poreforessional cleanser and i will never do that again. I do have sensitive skin and i have never ever felt this before. Feels like when you put a plumping lip gloss on, but on your face and it didnt go away for who knows how long. It burns as I'm typing this.
My boyfriend told me how smooth my skin was looking after I had been using after a couple weeks

The product does work, I have seen a change in my pore size, they seem smaller. But no matter how I use this it feels a bit sticky on my face and does has a horrible smell. I know this might not be the casr for everyone, but I did breakout after using this product.

Some of the comments have me shaking my head. This is a 'Pore' toner….. we do not have pores in our eyes, therefore, it should not go there, and it won't sting. I have super sensitive skin, and if anything, I found this to be too gentle for a AHA feel. It absolutely DOES NOT leave a residue on your face and or do you feel like you put anything on? That's how great it goes into the skin. But toners and specifically this delivery as it is foam, is best applied to damp skin as soon as you are done washing your face. If you've been sitting around for a long time, and your skin is completely dry, then you might feel something. Toners and serums are best. Applied to semi damp skin. Facial water sprays are a great tool if you've not dampened your skin. I find this product left my skin very glow after about six days of use. You can get rid of pours indefinitely. So no product is going to do that, but this product has definitely made my skin look glowy

This products is a skin-loving gem that excels in cleansing and minimizing pores. Formulated with gentle yet effective ingredients, this soap works wonders for a clean and refreshed complexion. Its powerful cleansing action removes impurities, leaving my skin soft!! The special formulation targets and minimizes pores, promoting a smoother appearance. Experience the refreshing sensation as this soap purifies your skin, leaving it with a healthy glow. For those seeking a soap that not only cleanses but also tackles pore concerns, I really love!! Offered by benefitcosmetics

This product is super sticky. Does not fully absorb into skin. Causes a large amount of whiteheads and large red cysts to appear on my face. I will never use anything from this brand ever again. DO NOT USE if you have sensitive skin or acne prone skin. I guarantee this will BREAK YOU OUT!!! I will probably go back to CERAVE or EUCERIN!! As those lotions did not tend to irritate my face. Seriously, DO NOT fall for it like i did. BIG MISTAKE. I am heart broken by this.

I have noticed from the first application that my pores are visibly smaller. As well, I could feel my skin tightening during the first application. I do use this twice daily as is listed and can tell a major difference in my skin as I have been using this product for a few weeks now. I do wish I would have bought the larger product, but I wanted to see if it was worth it first. I will be buying the larger product when I run out.

avis.titre: not bad but beware if you have acne or sensitive skin!
avis.texte: take this with a grain of salt because i have sensitive skin with a few blemishes here and there. ive been using this for about 6 weeks. when i first started using this product, it would sting REALLY bad on any little blemish i had, even the smallest ones. i continued to use it because i started to see a bit of a difference in my pores, but now it literally burns my whole face, i had to stop using it. maybe this would be good if you dont have any acne or you dont have sensitive skin, but i must warn anyone else who does!
I really like this toner! It does the job and I can wasily see that my pores look smaller! I might have to get the full size!

I received a travel size of this toner in an iPad bag a while back and I was shocked how quickly I noticed a change in my skin. Within 2 days my acne had significantly improved. I had to buy the full size and I love it!
AHA SHOULD NEVER BE USED WITH PHA My eyes got burned! Be careful 🧐

avis.titre: Probably will not buy again. Super drying for my combo skin
avis.texte: I'm in my late 30s and this toner is probably not for me. It is extremely drying on my skin. My pores are no more tightened than my previous toner. Will return to my previous one. My jaw line and forehead are so dry and my T-zone is still extremely oily.

This product will help your skin over all but you will need to use it regularly to see a difference. Day and night. If you stop and use it again you'll notice you might break out due to your skin adjusting but at the end youll be happy if you continue to use it. I would definitely buy it again and it last a long time 2 pumps will be plenty. You dont need a cotton pad or anything.

Got this in a sample pack. Foam goes to liquid quickly, didn't think I liked it. After a week of use, I do believe I do like it! Pores seem smaller, actually my skin at jaw line seems tightened. I've lost some weight, but I don't think that's it. Would've given 5 stars but haven't been using it long enough yet. I'll update later. Happy with it.
I havent used enough to see if it works but every time I use it my face breaks out

Im 46 years old and have used everything under the sun. I was using Elemis products right before i tried this and I absolutely love it! My pores look smaller and my skin feels tighter after usung it. I will continue to buy it.

avis.titre: Love this product and have ordered it several time, but...
avis.texte: after using it, does anyone else notice some tiny sparkles on their face?? It's annoying, but the product itself is so good that I keep using it. It's just annoying to have to pick the sparkles off!
absorbed quickly, and feels nice on my face. Skin did look quite a bit smoother too
Oily skin crew, this one is for you! I love the cooling and calming affect this has. Perfect for nighttime skincare.
If you're on the fence, Just get it! You will not regret it. After even two uses, your skin will feel and look like you just had a very expensive facial.
I cant say enough about this. I have horrible oily and textured skin, pores, the works. I am noticing a great difference in my skin.
I significantly dislike this product. it left a thick, greasy film on my skin. It felt incredibly icky and tacky

I have been using it for 21 days and my pores are loving it and now I saw a full cycle of the my skin regeneration and it really helped. I love the smell of the product as well, and enjoy having it in my skincare routine! Thankful to have it gifted by Benefit Cosmetics :)

avis.titre: I noticed a difference in my pores!
avis.texte: It felt nice and refreshing on my skin. Even after the first use I noticed that my pores seemed a bit smaller. I'm definitely a fan now.
Burns so bad for about 30 seconds when you out it on. Haven't seen any benefit after about 3 weeks of use, so it's a no for me.

I'm glad I'm not the only one who is reporting this and I never even write reviews. But the way this product burns and stings is a really alarming issue. It stung my face, my neck, even my finger tips! At least the parts that got under my nails. It is insane. Definitely do not use this if you have sensitive skin. I don't even think this should be used on any skin, to be honest. Also, I woke up with my face looking oilier than usual so there's that as well..

avis.titre: Nice after a while but BURNED at first
avis.texte: I honestly was really excited to try thus toner considering the foam pump packaging. It definitely irritated my skin at first and im not sure if it was supposed to burn like it did. After a few minutes it settled down and made my skin feel nice but people with sensitive skin or open wounds or acne on the face should def use with caution. Other than that, good toner.

I've never left a review before but omg. DO NOT try this if you have acne-prone skin. I was so excited to try this and I used it at night... I woke up this morning with a worse breakout than I've ever had in my life. Like so horrible I almost called out of work. I don't even understand how it happened that fast.

This product is a great way to introduce toner into your skincare routine. The foam form is convenient because it allows you to directly put it on your face with your hands. I like using this with Benefit's Deep Retreat mask. I was gifted by benefitcosmetics but my opinions are my own.
made my t-zone extra oily and after a week of daily use started breaking out. like other products but will return this one.

avis.titre: people are giving us a good review but I don't get it...
avis.texte: I have the mask and the cleanser and also purchased this toner. I love the mask and the cleanser but this product is a no-go for me. My skin was so sticky and my foundation would not apply evenly, even with my every day moisturizer. It just kind of sat on the surface and I only used one pump. I put it on my neck and my neck was so sick you had to wipe it off I also did not notice any poor shrinkage with this product. I'm going to keep the others but this is going to be returned
Used for 2 weeks. Face started breaking out after 3rd use. Would not recommend

Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics in exchange for my review. A great product for combination skin. I have enlarged pores, oily skin through my t zone and this really helped make my skin feel even the slightest bit balanced. I didn't necessarily notice my pores to be any smaller. The foam application is nice but makes my hands feel a little sticky.

This product is good, it's not my favorite product from this launch though. I do really like the foaming ability and how it applies to the skin. It overall does make your pores appear smaller along with all the other products in the line. This product was gifted by benefit cosmetics.

This toner is amazing! Truly tightens my pores and they become undetectable under makeup I am obsessed!! It makes my skin look so smooth and even I look forward to using this as much as I can aka every single day! This was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics!

avis.titre: Great new way to use a toner!!
avis.texte: This is such a fun way to introduce a toner product into a current skincare regimen. I'm loving the foam concept. Just apply two pumps into the hand and work the products onto the face after washing. Simple, easy and it works. I love Benefit's new skincare collection that helps us target a #1 skin concern which is PORES! The key really is to stay consistent with the products to see the change in the skin. I also use the mask and new moisturizer to keep my pores under control and have definitely seen a difference in my skin! The toning foam was gifted to me by Benefit Cosmetics in exchange for my thoughts and review on the product.

avis.titre: Not the best for sensitve skin
avis.texte: Not the best if you have skin abrasions. It burns. This is my least favorite from the pore care line. But if you do not have any skin abraions it does work well and I do like the Foam and the packaging.
I gave up on Toners, just never did anything to my skin. However this gave me instant results. It minimized the look of my texture and pore. It was amazing! Very impressed and will continue using

I didn't think pore reducers work, I have tried several with no results. This product actually works. I saw a difference on the 2nd day. People at work were telling me my skin looked great. Thank you for making a product that actually works. Tight and Toned pour product.

avis.titre: Another thing I wanted to love…
avis.texte: I tried this for a week solid, even though I probably should have stopped after the first use. It just wasn't for me. My skin has changed and it's more sensitive now than when I was younger. It burned immediately and left my already red skin, flaming red and tight. It could be great for others with more tolerance but I wouldn't recommend this for anyone with sensitive skin.

Love this product it has really helped my skin out by making my pores look smaller which is one of my highest concerns. Would definitely suggest this project to anyone with combination skin it also applies nicely and easily!

I received this toner complimentary from benefit cosmetics! This toner is very gentle and since I have sensitive skin but this stuff worked amazing on my skin. It cleaned out my pores so well! I love it!

Gifted by Benefit. Benefit pore products are great, so I was excited to try this! The bubbly foam upon application is pleasant, and I did see smaller pores after usage. I look forward to long-term results.

Gifted by Benefit. Benefit pore products are great, so I was excited to try this! The bubbly foam upon application was nice, and I did notice my pores looking smaller. I like that this also exfoliates. Look forward to long-term results.

This is one of my new favorite face wash. The packaging is so colorful and cute. The soap doesn't make my face oily nor dry wish is perfect for me. I love that I can also share it with my husband. And that it looks cute on display. "gifted by Benefit Cosmetics"

Overall this product was ok for me. I liked the foamy texture which was easy to apply on the skin. It does clear up the pores to some extent and blur it. It didn't make my skin look oily and I could feel my skin hydrated.

I've never tried a foaming toner and have never tried Benefit's skin care, so this was really interesting to try out! My skin tends to lean on the more sensitive side so I only used one pump on my face and neck. It didn't irritate my skin but I did feel a little bit of a tingle! It wasn't life changing but it didn't do any damage.

I've been using this foam everyday after cleansing for the past 2 weeks and have seen a difference in the appearance of my skin since day 1. I know it sounds silly to say you see immediate results but I felt my skin tingling as soon as I applied the foam to my skin and then also noticed my usual redness and irritation gone the morning of. I'll report back with any other changes with continued use. Right now I only use it at night and switch up my skincare for AM.

This was a great product. I love the pump application. It had a great sense and went on the face very light. You could visibly see a change in my pores on my skin. I would definitely recommend this product.

Gifted by benefit but all opinions are my own. I've always loved the benefit brand and was excited to try this product. First off who doesn't like a product where you do not need to use cloth or cotton round. The foam is light weight an applies super easy. I love that all though it's an exfoliant it's gentle. I have super sensitive skin and it works great!

I have very dry skin and haven't seen a significant difference in using it but it does have good properties so I will continue using it to see if I do see good results. But other than that I live the consistency. complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics
I love this toner!! leaves you skin feeling amazing the fact that it is a foam make it so easy to apply. This is the best product in this line! will be purchasing again for sure.

This is a different type of skincare product compared to what I've used before! I don't know if if it's made a huge difference in my skin, but I am a fan of the brand and this product has some good ingredients for my skin.

This is such a fun take on a toner and I was so surprised with how much i really loved it! I could feel my skin tighten immediately and it definitely helped diminish the appearance of my pores. Love that you can use your hands vs. a cotton pad also! complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics

Great formula with it being a foaming toner. Allows for no wastage. The two pumps is plenty for the whole face and one can use their hands. It did make my skin tingle with each use. I have sensitive skin so I used it every other day. Skin felt good after the tingling was gone

I've been using the foaming toner for about a week now. A little truly goes such a long way. I'm using it at night before my other skincare. You can feel a slight tingle and thats how I know its working. I haven't noticed a huge difference so far but my skin feels nice and clean! gifted by Benefit Cosmetics

I'm not sure if this happened because of combining it with another skincare product right after but this made my skin burn. I LOVE the concept of a foam toner, it's super easy to apple. I followed this with my typical serum and my skin was burning so I think I'll have to try again with different skincare.

I received this complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics, in exchange for my honest review, and I have to say, I'm truly impressed. As a busy mom getting ready in the morning, I absolutely love this product! The foam dispenser is so unique and easy to use, and a little bit goes a long way, which is a huge plus for me. I especially love incorporating it into my skincare routine before applying makeup to ensure a clean canvas. It's amazing how it makes me feel refreshed and ready to tackle the day ahead.

The toner was great! It was different from other toners on the market for sure. The foaming quality is so amazing. The application on the skin so easily. No need to use any cotton pads with this product you can just put it right on your hands.

The toner was different from all the ones I've ever used. The foaming quality is GENUIS. It applies on the skin so easily. No need to waste any more cotton pads you can just put it right on your hands.

i love this product. i love the fact that it's a foam toner because i have never seen one before, it's so lightweight and feels refreshing. ive definitely seen a change in my pores since i have been using it.

I wasn't sure what to expect from the POREfessional but I am loving it! I've heard great things about ABA and BHAs and this product has made my skin feel great and I have noticed less breakouts as well which was an unexpected plus! Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

i love the light foamy feeling of this cleanser. the bottle is pretty large and the pump works great for the foam. it is lightweight but gets the job done! i have noticed my skin is very glowy. does not feel sticky after which i like a lot.

avis.titre: No considerable difference but feels nice
avis.texte: I was really intrigued about this product and have enjoyed it so far. I haven't used it long enough to see any considerable differences, but the foam feels nice on the skin and serves the purpose of a toner. I'll keep using it to see if there is a difference in pore size. This was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

This product leaves my skin feeling and looking extremely clean and flawless. It's my first time trying and using a foam toner (a little goes a long way!) and it's super easy to use. I prefer to use it in the mornings to provide a bright, clean canvas prior to applying makeup. Highly recommend! Gifted by benefit for honest review.

Love this toner-foam! It is very gentle yet effective, but i still cannot use it every day, so i use it every other day and it gives amazing results with smoothing the skin out. i use it as the first step before my toner.

I've been using this Benefit toner along with the smooth sip moisturizer and have noticed an improvement in my pores! I love that this is a foam and the fact that you can apply it directly with your fingertips. I am excited to see the results with continued use. Definitely sticking with this in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Fun Foamy step to your skincare!
avis.texte: This toner definitely adds a fun foamy step to my skincare routine and it works well with the rest of my products. It absorbs quickly into the skin and it's very lightweight. I've been using it for the past two weeks and can definitely see a difference in my skin. As a dry skin girlie it does leave my skin a little tight after washing it off but still love the results!

I received this complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics. I like this toner is okay. My skin feels super clean after using it, but it leaves sticky residue. I have combination skin so it can leave my face feeling super tight.

I really love this toner ive tried a lot and some feel like they do nothing while others dry you out or sting. I've tried all the other products from this new line and this is one of my favorites . Gifted by benefit cosmetics but all opinions are my own.

I haven't been using this long enough to determine the real results, but first impression is that this toner is so fun! I love the foam and it makes it so easy to apply. It very quickly absorbs into my skin and works well with other products.

avis.titre: The POREfessionals Tight n' Toned Toner
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this product! From 1st use to about 2 weeks in, I can visibly see a difference. I have extremely large pores and nothing has seemed to minimize my pores effectively but this for the job done for sure!

I was gifted this product. It works well overall in refining the look of my pores. I've been applying 1-2 pump a morning and night to a clean face and I'm looking forward to seeing the results overtime

The first claim of instantly refining the look of pores is 100% legit! Upon application, I could physically feel my skin tightening! I love that it is a foam pump and I don't have to use cotton rounds. It's super convenient and mess free. My only con with this is I got a few pimples around my jaw line/neck area, so I'm not sure if something in this product was clearing out my pores in that spot? Nonetheless, I will continue using this to see if it improves my dry aging skin!

Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics. The toner is very good and works well on my skin. It does feel hydrating to a certain extent and works well with the other skincare in the range, so all in all I've been enjoying it.

I got this toner complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics, and I love the results. It's a bubbly foam that's very easy to apply with fingertips and it absorbs fast into the skin. My pores are smaller and skin looks healthier.

I've been using this for the past few days and I can tell a difference in my skin. My pores look smaller and skin is looking tighter! It does tingle just a tad bit only when my skin is freshly cleaned but not an issue

I love this and use this as part of my AM routine. Be careful as it can be strong to skin and may sting. Large pores is one of my skin issue and highly recommend this product. This was complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics along with the facial wash and I love using both!

I really love this toner, my skin looks so cute, bright and clear. My makeup looks so different now that I have all the skincare products from benefit. It looks super smooth, like a poreless effect everyday.

You know those products where you can feel them instantly working? This is one of those products. A couple hours after applying this toner my complexion looked more even and had a glow. I also love the packaging. Can't wait to try more products from this line!

I have the biggest pores in the world! I have used benefited porefssional and I love it so I wanted to try this product and benefit was kind enough to gifted to me and I love it!! My pores got smaller with in minutes!

This product refines the look of pores instantly and over time. Because it's foam, it's easy to apply daily on the face. I use it with other products, and I can see an improvement in my pores which is perfect for everyday makeup.

I recommend doing a patch test, especially if you have sensitive skin. I think I'll more than likely use this more often during the spring vs the summer and winter due to my skin getting more dry in the winter and too exposed to sun in the summer. I do really like the foam of the toner! gifted by Benefit Cosmetics

Benefit cosmetics gifted me the porefessional tight n toned foam and I am loving it. I have definitely noticed that my pores appear smaller. I like the foam. The consistency is so light and airy. It blends in my skin so perfect too.

This was a confusing product at first. Says 1-2 pumps of foam which is quite a bit. Was thinking is this skincare? Is this a base product for makeup? It did feel like it tightened and smoothed my skin.

I received this product gifted by Benefit Cosmetics but all opinions are my own. The Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Tight 'n Tone Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner is honestly so much better than I even expected! AWESOME on the nose!

Love trying out new and innovative beauty products! This mouse toner is super unique. I was worried that it would leave my face sticky or dry but it didn't. It dissolved into my face so nicely. It didn't irritate my skin or leave it dry. Looking forward to continue use as to see if it will tighten my pores.

The Benefit POREfessional Tight 'n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner makes my pores look considerably smaller right away and drastically helps the look of them over time. The AHAs + PHAs exfoliate my skin leaving it refined and beautiful.

The formula for this toning form was like nothing I have felt before. It is definitely a very innovative product that performs as it should and that you can use all over your body. I look forward to seeing the long term results after some more usage!

This is a great toner. I can see and feel a difference in my skin texture and appearance. I like to use this every other night, and my skin has been so soft and smooth since using it. This was sent complimentary from Benefit.

gifted by Benefit Cosmetics I've been using this for about a good week. I was very interested when I saw they created this. I had to get my hands on it and it went well. Very different I really thought it went well. I'm going to keep it up and see if it really helps more.

I enjoyed this toner. It felt good on my skin, and I noticed my skin felt softer after using it. I couldn't see a noticeable difference in my pores right away, but it felt good. I received this product as a gift to test out, complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics.

Omg I love the foaming effect! I've never tried a toner like this before and it is wonderful. It feels great on the skin and is really enjoyable to apply. My skin feels nice and this is great to use as a chemical exfoliant

This is my first time trying benefit skincare & so far I really like it! This toner is so cool where its a foam you just apply. It make's apply toner super easy. After using this product, my skin is super smooth and soft. I don't see a crazy difference in my pores but I don't have huge pores to begin with. I will definitely keep using it!

I recently had the pleasure of trying the Benefits Cosmetics Pore Refining AHA + PHA Spray Toner and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed with this product! From the very first use, I could feel the toner working to tighten and brighten my skin, while the clever foam bottle packaging ensured that the fine mist was evenly distributed across my face. The combination of AHA and PHA in the formula worked wonders to improve the texture of my skin and visibly reduce the size of my pores. Additionally, i'm in love with the fact that you can use it all over your body. This is something that you need in your body care routine. Overall, I highly recommend the Benefits Cosmetics Pore Refining AHA + PHA foam Toner to anyone seeking a sophisticated and effective addition to their skincare regimen. It has certainly become a staple in my own routine and I plan on using it for the foreseeable future.

I recently had the pleasure of trying the Benefits Cosmetics Pore Refining AHA + PHA Spray Toner and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed with this product! From the very first use, I could feel the toner working to tighten and brighten my skin, while the clever foam bottle packaging ensured that the fine mist was evenly distributed across my face. The combination of AHA and PHA in the formula worked wonders to improve the texture of my skin and visibly reduce the size of my pores. Additionally, i'm in love with the fact that you can use it all over your body. This is something that you need in your body care routine. Overall, I highly recommend the Benefits Cosmetics Pore Refining AHA + PHA foam Toner to anyone seeking a sophisticated and effective addition to their skincare regimen. It has certainly become a staple in my own routine and I plan on using it for the foreseeable future.

I received this complimentary from Benefit cosmetics to review. I have never tried a foam cleanser before and this is so interesting. I love the foamy texture. And it does tingle upon application and absorbs soo quickly and doesn't leave a tacky feeling.

I have been using the Porfessional Tight n Toned Toning Foam and honestly I have been seeing good results. My pores are still there BUT I do feel and see my pores looking cleaner and a bit less visible! I love that it's foam, it feels very hydrating on the skin. If you are looking for a toner to help clear your pores, this is the one!

The Pore fessional foam is perfect for my combination skin! The smell is great, not overwhelming at all. I love that it's a foam, the applicator is really nice and one pump goes a long way. I apply it after I wash my face and before I moisturize. It leaves my face feeling smooth and hydrated.

I've always looked for a toner that doesn't require using cotton balls. Feels wasteful. So I love the ease of this product and not having to waste any one time use products. Pairs well with the Benefit clay mask!
I'm loving Benefits new skin care! My face has felt so much better since using it! Simple, clean and feels so good!!

Omg I'm sooo Inlove with this foaming toner! Its the best toner ever! First of all, it's sooo satisfying to see how the foam melting into your skin, second of all skin feels so smooth and tight after. Now this step in my makeup prep is a must! Just try it for yourself!

This is so fun! I'm so glad benefit is coming out with skincare products! This comes in a super nice aluminum cab which makes it feel fancy and the foam comes out nice and cold. I've never used a foam toner but this was fun!

Didn't know what to expect when I first tried this but I can definitely say that I'm impressed! The formula is super gentle and non-irritating, but it does a great job tightening pores and making them look almost invisible.

I got the Pore Toner from complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics and it works so well. I use it in the morning and at night and because it is a foam consistency you don't need to use that much product, a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend.
